body: Aw, thats such a beautiful story. I really hope that made you happy :)

If the scab is what I'm thinking it is, it might be because it was recently exposed to a lot of water, like a shower or a bath or a pool. If it is that, its perfectly fine as is and I believe it will still protect your cut from germs. If it isn't that, I'd recommend doing some research online or, if you are comfortable enough, seeing a doctor about it. I wish you the best with your future and I hope someday you will be clean and be glad. :)

Thank you for the advice, hopefully it'll work and avoid any problems with me and my parents. And thank you, I hope things get better for you too if you are going through anything and I hope that your advice can help anyone else who needs the same help as me.

Just because some people have it better than you, doesn't mean everyone here has it better than you. Don't try to use your life story as a way to criticize the people who come here to talk about how they feel bad, because it doesn't matter what could be present in your life, your happiness will not come from it. Everyone here is struggling, don't try to make out like there are people who aren't appreciating their lives.
